title: 7.5. Saṅkiliṭṭhattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe….
Naasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe….
Naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnatiṁsa, ārammaṇe catuvīsa …pe… vipāke ekavīsa …pe… avigate ekūnatiṁsa.
